purpose: Map touched paths to optional module-level memory overlays.
usage: After Fast startup, compare touched files with path_globs.
Read matching module_memory files only when the current task touches that module.
If no glob matches, continue with global memory and source code.

modules.name: Frontend
modules.required_when: Task changes UI, client state, routes, styling, or browser-visible behavior.

modules.name: Backend
modules.required_when: Task changes server logic, APIs, background jobs, or service boundaries.

modules.name: Database
modules.required_when: Task changes schema, migrations, data access, seed data, or persistence behavior.
